description: Golden measurements for the B1.1 loudness/black analyzers against deterministic lavfi sources. These pin the analyzers end-to-end (real ffmpeg, real parse) rather than only the pure parsers, which unit tests already cover with canned logs. Regenerate by synthesizing each `lavfi` graph with the recorded encoder args and re-running the analyzer; only widen a tolerance with a reason. true_peak_tolerance is wider than lufs_tolerance because the AAC encoder's peak overshoot varies by ffmpeg build (-16.6 dBFS on ffmpeg 8.1, -17.3 on Ubuntu CI's apt build); a units/scaling bug would still miss by tens of dB.
